messages:
alex: Heads-up — proposing a Terraform change to add a fallback launch_template for spot GPU pools in us-west-2 to reduce interruption churn. Brief design below, want a quick review before I open the PR.
mira: SGTM. We need explicit tagging (cost_center + spot_role) and an interruption handler flag. Also please double-check AMI rotation won't break CUDA stacks.
sam: Can you paste the TF snippet? curious how you're selecting instance types and overrides.
alex: snippet:
```hcl
resource "aws_launch_template" "spot_fallback" {
  name = "inference-spot-fallback"
  image_id = var.fallback_ami
  instance_type = var.fallback_instance_type

  spot_options {
    instance_interruption_behavior = "stop"
  }

  tag_specifications {
    resource_type = "instance"
    tags = {
      "team" = "inference"
      "cost_center" = "platform"
      "spot_fallback" = "true"
    }
  }
}
```

jia: Stop behavior is fine for keeping local nvme cache, but remember stopped GPUs still incur EBS and reserved IP costs. Are we sure about that tradeoff for heavy ETL jobs?
alex: Good call. Plan: parametrize via `var.interruption_action` — stop for node-pools with ephemeral cache, terminate for stateless autoscaling groups. We'll add a cost check in the rollout checklist.
sam: On mixed-capacity pool: add `capacity_strategy = "capacityOptimized"` and include overrides for families (g4dn, g5, p3) + multiple AZs. That materially reduces replacements.
deploy-bot: note: new AMI bake landed -> /artifacts/amis/2026-03-10. CI will block if kernel/CUDA mismatch detected.
mira: Also need a cloud-init hook to re-register KV cache on resume; otherwise model warmups spike and latency SLOs break.
alex: Agreed — adding a systemd unit to handle on-resume: `systemctl start rdx-kv-restore.service`. Will include user-data in AMI and a small script to verify NVMe integrity. Also adding billing tags: `tags = { "spot_role" = "fallback" }`.
jia: Can we gate rollout with a canary? Suggest staging -> 10% prod -> 50% after 24h with metrics: interrupt_rate, median_p99_latency, cost_per_token.
alex: Yes — rollout plan: tf var `canary_percent` (default 0), staged applies: `-var 'canary_percent=0.1'`. We'll monitor `console/infra/spot-fallback` dashboard and an alert on interruption_rate > 5%.
sam: :thumbsup: also update SRE playbook: resume vs replace flow, and add automation to drain GPU cache gracefully before terminate.
alex: PR opened: https://git.company/redwood/infra/pull/482 — includes TF, user-data changes, and a README checklist. I'll run `terraform plan` in staging after approvals.
mira: Left a comment about pinning kernel and nvidia driver versions in AMI pipeline. Also request a `inference-pool:v2` unit tag so ops can distinguish during rollouts.
alex: Thanks, will incorporate. Merging after smoke tests pass and I'll post the rollout schedule + incident playbook here when we start canary.
